decisions.reason: The Vietnamese month/year order is natural and preserves both placeholders; the small width excess does not justify introducing an abbreviated date format without evidence.
This is gesture/camera instructional text; safely shortening it depends on whether the gesture pans, moves, or rotates the camera and on the overlay layout.
The song-list header is natural and within the normal header/dialog budget; removing 'Danh sách' would depend on screen context not present here.
On a ranking-status screen, the ranking noun is redundant; 'Chưa tham gia' preserves the distinct not-participating state without conflating it with being unranked.
'Hiện' and 'đang' duplicate the ongoing-state meaning; removing one produces the natural compact tallying status.
The month/year/rank label preserves all three placeholders and remains within the normal dialog/header budget; an abbreviated date form would be speculative.
The natural month/year format preserves both placeholders and is only marginally above a tiny-chip heuristic.
Repository-approved cramped-UI 'Uma' replaces the over-wide full form while preserving the representative-character meaning.
The not-yet-participated state is natural and already compact enough for a short status label.
The project consistently uses 'CLB' in compact Circle UI; the abbreviation preserves the dissolved-club state with much less width.

The action is clearly too wide, but shortening it safely requires knowing whether 'đối tác luyện tập' is an established feature name or screen-obvious context; inventing a new short term would be terminology curation.
On a list view, 'Danh sách' is redundant screen context; retaining the existing feature wording avoids terminology changes while materially reducing width.
The feature label itself is semantically clear; without an approved short form, replacing its terminology would exceed UI-review scope.
The sharing-state label is natural and only marginally above a tiny-chip heuristic.
The invalid-post error is natural, precise, and within the normal dialog/short-message budget; shorter alternatives would change nuance.
Polite filler and the locative phrase are unnecessary in a checkbox prompt; the direct instruction preserves the same operation with far less width.
The bulk-gift action is natural and already within the normal button budget.
The gift-count label is natural and already within the normal compact header/counter budget.
In the bulk-gift confirmation flow, the dialog content supplies the bulk context; the concise title preserves the confirmation function and avoids overflow.
The bulk-gift action is natural and already within the normal button budget.
